Events by quick date

Like an Angular Material search screen: a "Quick Date/Time" dropdown that defaults to the last 24 hours, a Clear button (so the search pass leaves this group alone as an action), a Search button that only click discovery presses, and a Show results button that only the disclosure pass presses. Events appear only for three months or more; every search is recorded with the preset it ran with.
